title: Warranty Coverage Rule on the Period for Counting Missed Visits of CareLine Service Plans Holders
content:
**Rule.** For a missed technician visit under Warranty Coverage, the missed visits counted depend on the owner's holding under the CareLine Service Plans:

- For an owner who holds an **active CareLine plan whose waiting period had ended by the date of the missed visit**, the missed visits counted are only the no-show visits on the registration dated **less than 12 whole months** before the date the fee is billed.
- For an owner who holds an **active On-Call Service Account**, they are only the no-show visits dated **less than 24 whole months** before the date the fee is billed.
- For every other owner no counting period applies under this rule.

## Terms used

- A **CareLine plan** is any plan of the CareLine Service Plans other than the On-Call Service Account: the CareLine Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year or Estate Plan.
- **Active** is the status of the plan or account on the CareLine Service Plans records.
- The **waiting period had ended by the date of the missed visit** when the missed visit is dated after the last day of that CareLine plan's waiting period, counted from the plan's enrolled date as the CareLine Service Plans records show it.
- **Whole months** are counted from the date of each no-show visit to the billing date, a month counting only once its day of the month has been reached.

## Holding and period

| Owner's holding on the CareLine Service Plans records | No-show visits counted |
|---|---|
| active CareLine plan, waiting period ended by the missed-visit date | those dated less than 12 whole months before the billing date |
| active On-Call Service Account | those dated less than 24 whole months before the billing date |
| any other holding, or none | no counting period under this rule |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical billing date 20 May 2032)

| No-show visit dated | Whole months before the billing date | Counted for a CareLine plan holder | Counted for an On-Call Service Account holder |
|---|---|---|---|
| 21 May 2031 | 11 | yes | yes |
| 20 May 2031 | 12 | no | yes |
| 21 May 2030 | 23 | no | yes |
| 20 May 2030 | 24 | no | no |

## Waiting period (hypothetical 30-day waiting period, enrolled 1 March)

The last waiting day is 31 March. A missed visit dated 31 March falls inside the waiting period, so the CareLine row does not apply; a missed visit dated 1 April falls after it.
